column1: # Repairs of terms the engine translates wrongly, applied to its answer before the masked parts
#     <english term> TAB <regular expression over the German text> TAB <replacement>
# A rule runs only on a message whose English text contains its term, so a generic German word can
# be repaired without touching other messages. Back-references (\1) are allowed, which keeps case
# endings. A change here translates again only the messages the rule applies to.
# the state of a job, never a country (Argos: "im Staat RUNNING")
# "the **prior** distribution": the glossary term already is a distribution
# "case" goes in as "Fall", which the engine then reads as the English "fall" (Argos: "in den Herbst-Einstellungen")
# "disabled" as a person, "bold" as courage, "check" as a cheque, "saving" as money (installation pages, review of 2026-11-06)
# a Linux distribution, not a statistical one
